regenerate_all_references: regenerate all reference values for TORAX unit tests and save to references.json
regenerate_specific_case: regenerate reference values for a specific TORAX test case like circular_references
regenerate_with_custom_output: regenerate TORAX references and write to a custom output directory instead of the default location
regenerate_dry_run: run TORAX reference regeneration in dry-run mode without writing to file
regenerate_with_summary: regenerate TORAX references and print full array summaries to the console for inspection
